title: Giving Advice & Suggestions
grammarNotes: 'Debería' is the conditional form of 'deber' — using the conditional instead of the plain present ('debes') softens a piece of advice from an obligation into a suggestion, much like 'should' versus 'must' in English.

'Yo que tú' and 'yo en tu lugar' (if I were you / in your place) are fixed idioms that use the conditional in the main clause but don't require any subjunctive — despite sounding hypothetical, they're set phrases, not full si-clauses.
'Sugerir/recomendar que' pull the subjunctive just like 'espero que' — 'te sugiero que lo pienses,' not 'que lo piensas' — the same subordinate-clause pattern from the Work and Movies units.

phrases.es: Te recomiendo que hables con ella
phrases.en: I recommend you talk to her
You should rest a bit more

phrases.es: Yo que tú, no lo haría
phrases.en: If I were you, I wouldn't do it

phrases.es: Yo en tu lugar, esperaría un poco
phrases.en: In your place, I'd wait a bit

phrases.es: Te sugiero que lo pienses mejor
phrases.en: I suggest you think it over

phrases.es: Mi consejo es que seas paciente
phrases.en: My advice is that you be patient
You should avoid that situation
What do you advise me to do?

phrases.es: Es mejor que lo resuelvas cuanto antes
phrases.en: It's better that you resolve it soon
You won't regret it
Dare to try it
Think it over well before deciding

phrases.es: Sería buena idea pedir otra opinión
phrases.en: It would be a good idea to ask for another opinion
Trust your instinct
You lose nothing by trying

phrases.es: Podrías empezar por lo más sencillo
phrases.en: You could start with the simplest thing
I suggest we talk calmly
The best thing would be to postpone it

phrases.es: Tarde o temprano tendrás que decidir
phrases.en: Sooner or later you'll have to decide
Tell me what's worrying you

sentences.es: Deberías hablar con tu jefe antes de tomar una decisión tan grande.
sentences.en: You should talk to your boss before making such a big decision.

sentences.es: Le sugiero que consulte con un especialista antes de proceder.
sentences.en: I suggest you consult a specialist before proceeding.

sentences.es: Che, yo que vos, no renunciaría todavía, esperaría un poco más.
sentences.en: Hey, if I were you, I wouldn't quit yet, I'd wait a bit longer.

sentences.es: Mi recomendación es que evalúe todas las opciones con calma.
sentences.en: My recommendation is that you calmly evaluate all the options.

sentences.es: Sé que es difícil, pero te aconsejo que lo hables con ella cuanto antes.
sentences.en: I know it's hard, but I advise you to talk to her about it as soon as possible.

sentences.es: Uy, yo en tu lugar, me arriesgaría, no pierdes nada con intentarlo.
sentences.en: Oh, in your place, I'd take the risk, you lose nothing by trying.

sentences.es: Le recomendamos encarecidamente que revise el contrato antes de firmar.
sentences.en: We strongly recommend you review the contract before signing.

sentences.es: No sé qué hacer, ¿qué me aconsejas?
sentences.en: I don't know what to do, what do you advise me?

sentences.es: Sería conveniente que ambas partes lleguen a un acuerdo lo antes posible.
sentences.en: It would be advisable for both parties to reach an agreement as soon as possible.

sentences.es: Piénsalo bien, no querés arrepentirte después de una decisión así.
sentences.en: Think it over well, you don't want to regret a decision like that later.

sentences.es: Le sugiero encarecidamente que busque una segunda opinión médica.
sentences.en: I strongly suggest you seek a second medical opinion.

sentences.es: Mira, mi consejo es simple: confía en tu instinto y ya.
sentences.en: Look, my advice is simple: trust your instinct and that's it.

sentences.es: Sería buena idea que hablaran los dos con calma, sin gritar.
sentences.en: It would be a good idea for the two of you to talk calmly, without shouting.

sentences.es: Agradecemos su consejo, lo tomaremos muy en cuenta.
sentences.en: We appreciate your advice, we'll take it very much into account.

sentences.es: Al final le hice caso a mi hermana y no me arrepiento para nada.
sentences.en: In the end I listened to my sister and I don't regret it at all.

dialogue.speaker: you
dialogue.es: Oye, o sea, necesito un consejo, no sé si aceptar el trabajo nuevo.
dialogue.en: Hey, I mean, I need some advice, I don't know whether to accept the new job.

dialogue.speaker: ignacio
dialogue.es: Mmm, pues cuéntame, ¿qué es lo que te preocupa exactamente?
dialogue.en: Mmm, well tell me, what exactly is worrying you?

dialogue.speaker: you
dialogue.es: Bueno, o sea, pagan mejor, pero tendría que mudarme de ciudad.
dialogue.en: Well, I mean, it pays better, but I'd have to move cities.

dialogue.speaker: ignacio
dialogue.es: Ah, ya veo, mira, yo en tu lugar, lo pensaría muy bien antes de decidir.
dialogue.en: Ah, I see, look, in your place, I'd think it over very carefully before deciding.

dialogue.speaker: you
dialogue.es: Sí, tienes razón, o sea, es una decisión bien grande.
dialogue.en: Yeah, you're right, I mean, it's a really big decision.

dialogue.speaker: ignacio
dialogue.es: Exacto, pero bueno, hagas lo que hagas, yo te voy a apoyar igual.
dialogue.en: Exactly, but well, whatever you decide, I'll support you either way.
